title: test_messages.py: Duplicate function name shadows security test (line 95)
description: Lines 95 and 144 both define test_rreq_from_bytes_rejects_invalid_hop_limit. Python silently overwrites the first with the second, so the test at lines 95-106 (which has a SECURITY comment about a DoS vector) never runs. pytest reports success but the security test is skipped. Rename one function (e.g., test_rreq_from_bytes_rejects_invalid_hop_limit_patched).
close_reason: Verified fixed: no duplicate definitions remain in any test_messages.py (AST-checked loadng/rpl/announce); hop-limit validation runs once and passes.
